sys_atf_test.description: Validates SnackFlow Sales Line Calc (before/150), SnackFlow Dispatch Stock Guard (before/160) and SnackFlow Dispatch Stock Posting (after/250) on a purpose-created sales order line. Asserts pending = ordered - dispatched on insert (100/0/100) and after a covered dispatch (100/40/60) which posts exactly the delta of 40; then asserts an over-dispatch beyond available stock is NOT updated and leaves the line and ledger untouched; finally asserts a downward correction saves but posts nothing to the ledger.
sys_atf_test.name: SnackFlow: pending quantity, dispatch stock guard and downward corrections
